decisions.evidence: R1 maker presents duplicate handling as 'Behaviors covered: duplicate-URL warning'. R1 client: 'saving an existing address should take me to the existing bookmark to update it rather than merely warning me'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented 'warning' diverges from REF-BM-06 (guide user to edit the existing bookmark). Divergence established from the presentation itself, independent of the request. Client rejects the warning and supplies the reference-conforming behavior -> corrective/correct.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'P2 — Edit & delete: fix a title or remove a bookmark'. R1 client: 'editing should allow me to correct the address as well as its other details'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Edit was presented but limited to the title; address (url) editing, a required part of REF-BM-04, was missing from the presented scope. Client requests the missing reference requirement -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec omits any read/unread feature (P1 save/browse, P2 edit/delete, P3 search/tags only). R1 client: 'Mark bookmarks as unread/read-later, with a separate view for them and a way to mark them read'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Read-later state (17), separate unread view (18), and mark-as-read (19) were absent from the presented spec (divergence established from the omission). Client surfaces and requests them in one coherent utterance -> extend. Confirmed added in R2 presentation (single decision, not double-counted).

decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec omits archiving. R1 client: 'Archive bookmarks so they disappear from the normal list without being permanently deleted, with a separate archive view and a way to restore them'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Archive-hides-without-deleting (26), archive-vs-delete distinction/reversibility (27), and separate archive view (28) absent from presentation. Client requests them, explicitly contrasting archive with permanent deletion -> extend. Confirmed added in R2.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope boundary: 'Local persistence — no cross-device sync, cloud backup, or browser import/export in v1.' R1 client: 'I'm also comfortable leaving import/export for later.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Import/export are reference extended items (30/31); the maker presents them as deferred out of v1 (departure from reference). The client explicitly names import/export as the expectation and accepts the departure without requesting alignment -> accepted_divergence (catch_type none). Reference remains fixed.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Auto page-title fetching is best-effort — you can always set titles manually'; save takes 'optional title, description, tags' as user input. R5 maker: US1 'title auto-derived'. Client never mentions auto-collection; approves at R2 'Yes, this now matches what I have in mind.'
decisions.note: Spec gate presentation. Auto-collection was presented as title-only, diverging from REF-BM-02 (auto-collect title, description, favicon, AND preview image). No client corrective or explicit expression of the difference at any round -> unexpressed_divergence.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'P3 — Find by search & tags: keyword search + tag filtering'. R5 maker: US6 'keyword + tag filtering'. Client never engages search details; R4 client 'the task breakdown covers the agreed features', R5 accepts.
decisions.note: Spec gate presentation. Search was concretely presented in reduced form, omitting #tag syntax (14), AND/OR/NOT + parenthesised groups with literal-quoting rule (15), and quoted exact-phrase matching (16). Client never surfaced or expressed these -> unexpressed_divergence.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Behaviors covered: ... "recently added first" ordering'. R5 maker: US2 'list newest-first'. No selectable sort presented or requested at any round.
decisions.note: Spec gate presentation. A fixed newest-first ordering was presented, diverging from REF-BM-22 (user-selectable sort key: date added, title, etc.). Never contested or expressed by the client -> unexpressed_divergence.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'P1 — Save a bookmark: paste a URL ...; it's validated and persisted'. R1 client: priorities fine, scope acceptable.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented save-by-URL conforms to REF-BM-01. Recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Browse & open: ... click to open the original page in a new tab'. Client approves scope.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented open-original-on-select conforms to REF-BM-08. Recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Edit & delete: ... remove a bookmark, with a delete confirmation'. Client: priorities fine.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented delete-with-confirmation conforms to REF-BM-05. Recorded conforming decision (delete scope; note edit-url portion handled separately under REF-BM-04).
